hints.sentence: A rep's cellar count is of the full containers of a line on its order day, and the empties wait there for the dray, so what the trade holds is more than the counts show and does not move in step with its sales.
The store receives each beer a whole racking run at a time, so its stock follows the runs and the number of beers on sale, and both change in 2027.
A container lost in the trade is never taken off the register, so the register is not the fleet and nothing records how many are lost.

judgments.name: a cellar check is of the full containers of a line on the account's order day, so what each checked line held is rebuilt from the dray's last call and the line's weekly sales before what a line holds is fitted and carried to the trade's summer peak
the store's stock is split into its cover and the measured share of a racking run for each beer on sale, and rebuilt from the 2027 brew plan's runs, range and on-sale dates
the containers the trade loses are estimated from the share of each purchase lot found on site against the lot's age, the share on site fitted beside the rate, never taken as nil
the dockets, the checks, the count and the register cleaned: re-sent docket lines, blank container codes, renumbered accounts, three container codings, lot prefixes, a line checked twice
deliveries fitted on the season, the trend and the week's temperature, held out and run through the recorded summers
the estate's new lines sized from the schedule and carried at the fitted relation
the worst week found over every week of the season, in each case
the standard's requirement, fleet, season, cases, float and lines as filed
the register, the count and the dockets reconciled to one account by pool, the condemnations netted
